evidence.title: GitHub - michael-andreuzza/bearnie: Accessible components for Astro and Tailwind CSS. Components are copied to your project. You own and control the code. · GitHub

name: Bearnie
summary: 50+ accessible Astro components in the shadcn copy-paste style, with a CLI, an MCP server and 160+ color palettes.
description: A copy-paste component library for Astro and Tailwind CSS: 50+ accessible components install with npx bearnie add and ship as plain Astro + vanilla JavaScript, with no React, Vue or Svelte runtime. Comes with a CLI (init, add, diff, update, barrel), an MCP server (@bearnie/mcp) so AI assistants can add components, 160+ color palettes, light and dark theming with CSS variables, WCAG 2.1 AA behaviour, and a create-bearnie starter for new projects.
contains: 50+ accessible components for Astro and Tailwind CSS; plain Astro + vanilla JS, zero client JS by default
install: npx bearnie init, then npx bearnie add button dialog …; create-bearnie scaffolds new projects
160+ color palettes; light/dark via CSS variables; npx bearnie diff and update keep components in sync
MCP server @bearnie/mcp: list_components, search_components, get_component, add_component(s)
WCAG 2.1 AA defaults: keyboard navigation, screen reader support, focus management, progressive enhancement
registry 0.6.0–0.12.0 adds calendar, navigation menu, timeline, marquee, banner, tables, sidebar icon rail
